title: QuSema: Detecting Silent Bugs in Quantum Libraries via Quantum-knowledge-enhanced Agents
title_zh: QuSema: Detecting Silent Bugs in Quantum Libraries via Quantum-knowledge-enhanced Agents

paragraphs.en: Quantum libraries are now critical infrastructure for quantum algorithm development, yet their correctness remains difficult to test. Existing testing techniques mainly rely on failure-based or comparison-based oracles, exposing bugs only when executions fail, violate runtime checks, or disagree with another implementation. Their applicability is limited when suitable execution-based oracles are unavailable, leaving some silent bugs undetected. Such missed bugs can produce incorrect results that propagate into experimental conclusions, simulation studies, and algorithmic designs. Here we present QuSema, an autonomous testing agent for finding silent bugs in quantum libraries. QuSema uses constraints from quantum semantics and documentation as a source-level semantic oracle to assess whether implementation logic can produce invalid outputs from valid inputs. It operates through an agentic loop that repeatedly inspects library API documentation and source code, reasons about the intended behavior of quantum operations, identifies potential semantic deviations, and validates them by generating executable tests through library APIs. Guided by quantum-domain reasoning, QuSema turns high-level behavioral mismatches into concrete, user-triggerable bug reports, enabling it to uncover non-crash defects. We implement QuSema for Qiskit and PennyLane. On a benchmark of 20 historical silent bugs, QuSema achieves higher mean bug relocation counts than Claude Code and Codex, with the DeepSeek configuration costing less than Claude Code. QuSema also discovers 40 previously unknown bugs confirmed by the developers, including 30 silent bugs.
paragraphs.zh: 量子库如今已成为量子算法开发的关键基础设施，但其正确性仍然难以验证。 现有的测试技术主要依赖基于故障或基于比较的预言机，只有在执行失败、违反运行时检查或与另一实现不一致时才能暴露错误。 当没有合适的执行型预言机时，这些技术的适用性会受到限制，导致某些静默错误无法被检测出来。 这类未被发现的错误可能产生不正确的结果，并进一步影响实验结论、模拟研究和算法设计。 在此，我们提出 QuSema——一种用于发现量子库中静默错误的自主测试智能体。 QuSema 利用量子语义和文档中的约束条件作为源级语义预言机，以评估实现逻辑是否可能从有效输入中产生无效输出。 它通过一个智能体循环运行：反复检查库的 API 文档和源代码，推理量子操作的预期行为，识别潜在的语义偏差，并通过库 API 生成可执行测试来验证这些偏差。 在量子领域推理的指导下，QuSema 能将高层的行为不匹配转化为具体且可由用户触发的错误报告，从而发现非崩溃类缺陷。 我们为 Qiskit 和 PennyLane 实现了 QuSema。 在包含 20 个历史静默错误的基准测试中，QuSema 的平均错误定位次数高于 Claude Code 和 Codex，且 DeepSeek 配置的成本低于 Claude Code。 QuSema 还发现了 40 个此前未知的错误（经开发者确认），其中包括 30 个静默错误。

paragraphs.en: Quantum computing ( Dalzell et al., 2025 ; Nielsen and Chuang, 2001 ) offers the potential to tackle computational problems beyond the reach of classical methods, with promising applications in quantum chemistry ( McArdle et al., 2020 ) , optimization ( Abbas et al., 2024 ) , and machine learning ( Cerezo et al., 2022 ) . To facilitate the design and refinement of quantum algorithms, quantum software libraries such as Qiskit ( Javadi-Abhari et al., 2024 ) and PennyLane ( Bergholm et al., 2018 ) have been developed and widely adopted. These libraries provide essential support for building, simulating, and executing quantum algorithms, and have become critical infrastructure in the quantum software ecosystem. However, quantum software is still in its early stage, and these rapidly evolving libraries contain bugs that lead to incorrect or unexpected behaviors ( Paltenghi and Pradel, 2022 ) . Accordingly, systematic quantum software testing ( Dwivedi et al., 2024 ) is becoming increasingly essential for building a reliable and robust quantum software ecosystem.
paragraphs.zh: 量子计算（Dalzell 等人，2025；Nielsen 和 Chuang，2001）有望解决经典方法无法处理的计算问题，并在量子化学（McArdle 等人，2020）、优化（Abbas 等人，2024）和机器学习（Cerezo 等人，2022）等领域展现出广阔的应用前景。 为了促进量子算法的设计与完善，诸如 Qiskit（Javadi-Abhari 等人，2024）和 PennyLane（Bergholm 等人，2018）等量子软件库已被开发出来并得到广泛应用。 这些软件库为构建、模拟和执行量子算法提供了关键支持，已成为量子软件生态系统中至关重要的基础设施。 然而，量子软件仍处于早期发展阶段，这些快速演进的软件库中存在可能导致错误或不期望行为的缺陷（Paltenghi 和 Pradel，2022）。 因此，系统化的量子软件测试（Dwivedi 等人，2024）对于构建可靠且稳健的量子软件生态系统正变得日益重要。

paragraphs.en: Substantial research effort has been devoted to quantum software testing, particularly automated bug detection for quantum libraries ( Paltenghi and Pradel, 2024a ) . Existing approaches have shown promising results ( Xia et al., 2026 ; Xia et al., 2024 ) for crash bugs ( Rosa and Santiago, 2026 ) , where exceptions or program termination provide explicit failure signals. Beyond crash bugs, quantum libraries also contain silent bugs ( Zappin et al., 2026 ) , which return incorrect results that violate intended behavior or quantum semantics without explicit failures. For example, a quantum library may return an incorrect commutativity judgment for a pair of quantum operators ( Qiskit Developers, 2026c ) or apply a quantum circuit optimization method that does not preserve semantics of the original circuit ( Qiskit Developers, 2024b ) . These incorrect but undetected results can propagate through downstream workflows, which in turn mislead algorithm design, lead to erroneous hardware executions, and waste quantum computing resources ( Upadhyay et al., 2026 ) . To mitigate these risks and improve reliability, quantum software testing should be capable of effectively detecting silent bugs in quantum libraries.
paragraphs.zh: 大量研究精力已投入量子软件测试领域，尤其是针对量子库的自动化错误检测（Paltenghi 和 Pradel，2024a）。 现有方法在检测崩溃类错误方面已取得令人鼓舞的结果（Xia 等人，2026；Xia 等人，2024），这类错误中异常或程序终止会提供明确的故障信号（Rosa 和 Santiago，2026）。 除了崩溃类错误，量子库还包含静默错误（Zappin 等人，2026），这些错误会返回违反预期行为或量子语义的错误结果，但不会引发明显的故障。 例如，量子库可能对一对量子算子给出错误的交换性判断（Qiskit Developers，2026c），或应用无法保留原始电路语义的量子电路优化方法（Qiskit Developers，2024b）。 这些错误但未被检测到的结果可能会在下游工作流中传播，进而误导算法设计、导致错误的硬件执行，并浪费量子计算资源（Upadhyay 等人，2026）。 为缓解这些风险并提升可靠性，量子软件测试应能有效检测量子库中的静默错误。

paragraphs.en: Current approaches to silent bug detection in quantum libraries mainly rely on differential testing ( Wang et al., 2021 ; Klimis et al., 2025 ; Blackwell et al., 2024 ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Paltenghi and Pradel, 2025 ) and metamorphic testing ( Paltenghi and Pradel, 2023 ; Kitt and Cohen, 2024 ; Luo et al., 2026 ) . Differential testing analyzes the same quantum circuit across different quantum software stacks and checks whether equivalent outputs are observed ( Andrews et al., 2026 ) . Metamorphic testing instead applies transformations that should preserve circuit semantics, such as inserting identities or replacing a gate with an equivalent decomposition, and checks the expected relations between execution results from the source and transformed programs ( Fortunato et al., 2024 ) . Both approaches use black-box test oracles ( Rigger and Su, 2022 ) to validate expected relations between execution results ( Gao et al., 2026 ) . While these approaches have successfully detected silent bugs in quantum libraries ( Wang et al., 2021 ; Klimis et al., 2025 ; Blackwell et al., 2024 ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Paltenghi and Pradel, 2025 ; Paltenghi and Pradel, 2023 ; Kitt and Cohen, 2024 ; Luo et al., 2026 ) , their reliance on black-box test oracles introduces two fundamental limitations.
paragraphs.zh: 当前量子库中静默错误检测的方法主要依赖差异测试（Wang 等人，2021；Klimis 等人，2025；Blackwell 等人，2024；Ye 等人，2026；Paltenghi 和 Pradel，2025）以及形态测试（Paltenghi 和 Pradel，2023；Kitt 和 Cohen，2024；Luo 等人，2026）。 差异测试通过在不同量子软件栈上分析相同的量子电路，并检查是否观察到等效的输出（Andrews 等人，2026）。 形态测试则应用能够保持电路语义的变换，例如插入恒等操作或用等效分解替换某个门，并验证原始程序与变换后程序的执行结果之间的预期关系（Fortunato 等人，2024）。 这两种方法都使用黑盒测试预言机（Rigger 和 Su，2022）来验证执行结果之间的预期关系（Gao 等人，2026）。 尽管这些方法已成功检测出量子库中的静默错误（Wang 等人，2021；Klimis 等人，2025；Blackwell 等人，2024；Ye 等人，2026；Paltenghi 和 Pradel，2025；Paltenghi 和 Pradel，2023；Kitt 和 Cohen，2024；Luo 等人，2026），但它们对黑盒测试预言机的依赖带来了两个根本性限制。

paragraphs.en: (L1). Limited Availability of Expected Relations Between Execution Results . Some quantum library functionalities lack either semantically corresponding implementations across libraries for differential testing or circuit transformations with predictable output relations for metamorphic testing. For example, PennyLane supports the resource-estimation functionality ( PennyLane, 2026 ) for predefined algorithms, while Qiskit has no counterpart ( Qiskit Developers, 2026t ) , and semantics-preserving transformations may still change resource quantities such as gate count or circuit depth. Consequently, approaches that employ black-box test oracles cannot provide complete coverage of quantum library functionality.
paragraphs.zh: (L1). 执行结果之间预期关系的可用性有限。 某些量子库功能要么在跨库的语义对应实现上缺乏支持，无法进行差异测试；要么在电路转换中缺乏可预测的输出关系，无法进行形态变化测试。 例如，PennyLane 支持预定义算法的资源估算功能（PennyLane, 2026），而 Qiskit 却没有对应的功能（Qiskit Developers, 2026t）；此外，保持语义的转换仍可能改变门数量或电路深度等资源指标。 因此，采用黑盒测试预言机的方法无法对量子库的功能实现全面覆盖。

paragraphs.en: (L2). Ineffective Triggering Without Semantic Guidance . Many quantum-software functionalities involve complex mathematical semantics ( Salam and Ilyas, 2024 ) , and their bugs are triggered only under specific semantic conditions ( Leite Ramalho et al., 2025 ) . Such conditions may involve specific parameter values, quantum operations, or circuit layouts ( Hu et al., 2024 ) . Generic program generation may require extensive exploration to trigger these conditions ( Li et al., 2026 ) , limiting the effectiveness of black-box testing.
paragraphs.zh: (L2). 缺乏语义指导的无效触发。 许多量子软件功能涉及复杂的数学语义（Salam 和 Ilyas，2024），其错误仅在特定的语义条件下才会被触发（Leite Ramalho 等，2025）。 这些条件可能涉及特定的参数值、量子操作或电路布局（Hu 等，2024）。 通用程序生成可能需要大量的探索才能触发这些条件（Li 等，2026），从而限制了黑盒测试的有效性。

sents.en: Generic program generation may require extensive exploration to trigger these conditions ( Li et al., 2026 ) , limiting the effectiveness of black-box testing.

paragraphs.en: To address these limitations, we develop QuSema, an automated agent for detecting silent bugs in quantum libraries by auditing Qu antum Sema ntics. Its design follows our data-flow analysis, which localizes a silent bug to the library API that first transforms a valid input into an invalid output. Our study of reported bugs in Qiskit and PennyLane provides supporting evidence for this localization. QuSema therefore targets such API-local semantic deviations by directly analyzing the relevant implementation logic. More precisely, QuSema employs large language models (LLMs) ( Wei et al., 2025 ; Mikuriya et al., 2025 ) to reason about implementation behavior using relevant quantum semantics and documentation. This information serves as a source-level semantic oracle for identifying candidate defects, which are subsequently validated through execution and checked for triggerability through documented library APIs. This design brings quantum semantics into source-level correctness reasoning and extends silent bug detection beyond cases covered by existing execution-based relations.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决这些局限性，我们开发了 QuSema——一种自动智能体，通过审计量子语义来检测量子库中的静默错误。 其设计基于我们的数据流分析，该分析能将静默错误的定位锁定在首个将有效输入转换为无效输出的库 API 上。 我们对 Qiskit 和 PennyLane 中已报告错误的研究为这种定位方法提供了支持性证据。 因此，QuSema 通过直接分析相关实现逻辑，针对此类位于 API 层面的语义偏差展开检测。 更具体地说，QuSema 利用大型语言模型（LLMs）（Wei et al., 2025；Mikuriya et al., 2025），结合相关的量子语义和文档来推理实现行为。 这些信息充当了源代码层面的语义“神谕”，用于识别候选缺陷，随后通过执行验证这些缺陷，并借助文档化的库 API 检查其可触发性。 这种设计将量子语义引入了源代码层面的正确性推理中，并将静默错误的检测范围扩展到了现有基于执行的检测方法所覆盖不到的情形。

paragraphs.en: We systematically evaluate QuSema on Qiskit and PennyLane, two widely used quantum libraries. On a benchmark of 20 historical silent bugs, QuSema substantially outperforms Claude Code and Codex in localizing known defects. When instantiated with DeepSeek as its LLM backend, QuSema achieves this performance at a lower estimated cost than Claude Code and a comparable cost to Codex. Beyond historical benchmarks, applying QuSema to real-world quantum libraries uncovers 40 previously unknown bugs confirmed by developers, including 30 silent bugs. The identified bugs span quantum-program execution, semantic analysis, and library infrastructure. Notably, five of these silent bugs affect functionalities that lack either comparable implementations or suitable circuit transformations with known output relations. Such bugs fall beyond the detection scope of existing differential and metamorphic testing methods. These results validate the practical value of grounding source code inspection in quantum semantics for systematic silent bug detection across large quantum libraries.

paragraphs.en: Quantum Library Functionality. Quantum libraries provide functionality in three main categories: Quantum programming language , Compilation , and Execution environment ( Paltenghi and Pradel, 2022 ) . The first provides quantum and classical abstractions, such as gates, circuits, matrices, and tensors, together with domain-specific abstractions for quantum algorithms. Compilation supports intermediate representations, circuit optimization, and code generation. The execution environment provides hardware interfaces, simulators, and quantum state evaluation, including measurement and error mitigation. Auxiliary components support testing, visualization, and software integration. Individual libraries implement different parts of this functionality.
paragraphs.zh: 量子库功能。 量子库主要在三个类别中提供功能：量子编程语言、编译和执行环境（Paltenghi 和 Pradel，2022）。 第一类提供量子与经典抽象概念，例如门、电路、矩阵和张量，以及用于量子算法的领域特定抽象。 编译支持中间表示、电路优化和代码生成。 执行环境提供硬件接口、模拟器和量子态评估功能，包括测量和错误缓解。 辅助组件支持测试、可视化和软件集成。 各个库负责实现这些功能的不同部分。

paragraphs.en: Bugs can manifest as explicit crashes such as exceptions and resource exhaustion, or as silent bugs that produce incorrect behavior without interrupting execution ( Rosa and Santiago, 2026 ) . An empirical study ( Paltenghi and Pradel, 2022 ) shows that quantum-specific bugs frequently manifest as incorrect outputs rather than crashes. Accordingly, silent bug detection in quantum libraries has received substantial attention. Existing methods in this context primarily fall into two categories.
paragraphs.zh: 错误可能表现为显式的崩溃，例如异常和资源耗尽，也可能表现为静默错误，即在不中断执行的情况下产生不正确行为（Rosa 和 Santiago，2026）。 一项实证研究（Paltenghi 和 Pradel，2022）表明，量子特定的错误通常表现为不正确的输出，而非程序崩溃。 因此，量子库中的静默错误检测已受到广泛关注。 在此领域，现有方法主要可分为两类。

paragraphs.en: Differential Testing. Quantum differential testing detects inconsistencies by comparing corresponding executions across different quantum software stacks ( Andrews et al., 2026 ) . Concretely, QDiff ( Wang et al., 2021 ) and QITE ( Paltenghi and Pradel, 2025 ) derive comparable programs through program transformations. Blackwell et al. ( Blackwell et al., 2024 ) and FuzzQ ( Klimis et al., 2025 ) employ fuzzing to generate test programs, guided respectively by predefined grammars and constraints from a formal model. QSPE ( Ye et al., 2026 ) systematically enumerates program variants from skeletal programs and compares their final state vectors.

paragraphs.en: Metamorphic Testing. Quantum metamorphic testing applies transformations that should preserve circuit semantics and checks whether the resulting executions satisfy expected relations ( Fortunato et al., 2024 ) . Specifically, MorphQ ( Paltenghi and Pradel, 2023 ) derives transformed programs using quantum metamorphic relations, while MorphQ++ ( Kitt and Cohen, 2024 ) extends these transformations to additional circuit representations and transpilation settings. QEMI ( Luo et al., 2026 ) constructs equivalent program variants by eliminating code that does not affect selected inputs in quantum programs with control flow. These methods exercise circuit construction, compilation, and execution, involving functionality from the three categories introduced in Sec. 2.2 . Moreover, their applicability to individual functionalities depends on whether corresponding executions or suitable circuit transformations can be constructed.

paragraphs.en: Differential and metamorphic testing rely on black-box test oracles that evaluate relations between execution results. Their applicability therefore depends on the availability of comparable executions or suitable metamorphic relations, leaving some quantum library functionalities difficult to test. In contrast, QuSema derives semantic oracles directly from source-level implementation logic, enabling silent bug detection without requiring such predefined relations.
paragraphs.zh: 差异测试和形态测试依赖于黑盒测试预言机，这些预言机用于评估执行结果之间的关系。 因此，它们的应用性取决于是否存在可比较的执行或合适的形态关系，这使得某些量子库功能难以测试。 相比之下，QuSema 直接从源代码级别的实现逻辑中推导出语义预言机，从而无需依赖此类预定义关系即可检测隐藏的错误。

paragraphs.en: LLM-based Testing . Recent studies have explored large language models (LLMs) for test generation, input construction, fuzzing, and debugging ( Deng et al., 2023 ; Deng et al., 2024 ; Xia et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024a ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Altmayer Pizzorno and Berger, 2025 ; Pham et al., 2026 ) . In contrast, QuSema uses the LLM to analyze implementation logic and identify potential semantic deviations. These candidates are subsequently verified and checked for triggerability through documented library APIs.

paragraphs.en: In this section, we analyze the limitations of existing silent bug detection methods in quantum libraries and explore source-level semantic evidence as a potential basis for broader and more efficient bug detection. For clarity, we first analyze two limitations of existing approaches employing black-box test oracles in Sec. 3.1 , namely (L1) incomplete functionality coverage due to unavailable expected relations between execution results and (L2) inefficient bug triggering without semantic guidance. We then analyze in Sec. 3.2 how data flow can be used to localize semantic deviations to individual library APIs and examine reported bugs to support this analysis. Finally, in Sec. 3.3 , we discuss the implications and challenges of using this evidence for reliable silent-bug detection.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们分析了现有量子库静默缺陷检测方法的局限性，并探讨了源代码层面的语义证据作为更广泛、更高效缺陷检测潜在基础的可能性。 为清晰起见，我们在第 3.1 节中首先分析了采用黑盒测试预言机的现有方法的两项局限性，即 (L1) 因无法获取执行结果之间的预期关系而导致的覆盖功能不完整，以及 (L2) 缺乏语义指导时触发缺陷的效率低下。 接着，我们在第 3.2 节中分析了如何利用数据流将语义偏差定位到单个库 API，并通过检查已报告的缺陷来支持这一分析。 最后，在第 3.3 节中，我们讨论了利用这些证据进行可靠静默缺陷检测所带来的影响与挑战。

paragraphs.en: Existing approaches for detecting silent bugs in quantum libraries, particularly differential and metamorphic testing introduced in Sec. 2.3 , mainly rely on black-box test oracles ( Rigger and Su, 2022 ) . They have shown effectiveness for functionalities such as circuit execution and compilation, yet two limitations defined in Sec. 1 (i.e., (L1) and (L2) ) remain. For some quantum library functionalities, the expected relations between execution results cannot be established. This occurs when cross-library counterparts are unavailable or circuit-level transformations do not yield predictable output relations. Moreover, many silent bugs are triggered only under specific quantum semantic conditions, making generic program generation inefficient. Below, we elaborate on these two limitations with representative examples in Fig. 1 .

paragraphs.en: In this section, we analyze how silent bugs arise along the data flow of quantum programs and how their origins can be identified from source-level semantic evidence. Specifically, we first characterize silent bugs as semantic deviations that produce invalid outputs from valid inputs and localize each deviation to the first library API that introduces it. We then use a representative bug to illustrate how inconsistencies between implementation logic and quantum semantics or documentation provide evidence for identifying such defects.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们分析了静默错误如何在量子程序的数据流中产生，以及如何从源代码层面的语义证据中识别其来源。 具体来说，我们首先将静默错误定义为从有效输入产生无效输出的语义偏差，并将每个偏差定位到引入该偏差的第一个库 API。 接着，我们通过一个典型错误来说明实现逻辑与量子语义或文档之间的不一致性如何为识别此类缺陷提供证据。

paragraphs.en: Characterization of Silent Bugs. We consider an input or output valid if it satisfies the relevant quantum semantics and does not violate the documentation, and invalid otherwise. At the code-segment level, validity also includes applicable software semantics, since local implementation logic may manipulate objects not fully constrained by quantum semantics. Under these criteria, a silent bug is characterized by a semantic deviation that produces an invalid output from a valid input without an explicit failure signal.
paragraphs.zh: 静默错误的特征分析。 如果输入或输出满足相关的量子语义且未违反文档说明，则视为有效；否则视为无效。 在代码段层面，有效性还包括适用的软件语义，因为局部实现逻辑可能会操作那些未完全受量子语义约束的对象。 根据这些标准，静默错误的特征在于其语义偏差会导致有效输入产生无效输出，而不会出现明确的失败信号。

sents.en: At the code-segment level, validity also includes applicable software semantics, since local implementation logic may manipulate objects not fully constrained by quantum semantics.
sents.zh: 在代码段层面，有效性还包括适用的软件语义，因为局部实现逻辑可能会操作那些未完全受量子语义约束的对象。

sents.en: Under these criteria, a silent bug is characterized by a semantic deviation that produces an invalid output from a valid input without an explicit failure signal.
sents.zh: 根据这些标准，静默错误的特征在于其语义偏差会导致有效输入产生无效输出，而不会出现明确的失败信号。

paragraphs.en: Localization of Semantic Deviations. A quantum program may invoke multiple library APIs, with the output of one call serving as input to subsequent calls. Within this flow, we treat each library API as a data-transformation unit from its received input to its resulting output. For an execution exhibiting a silent bug, the first library API that transforms a valid input into an invalid output introduces the semantic deviation and is identified as its origin. Earlier calls preserve validity, while later calls may only propagate or expose the resulting incorrect behavior. This data-flow view localizes the semantic deviation to an individual library API. To examine whether reported bugs provide counterexamples to this localization, we screened 3,184 bug reports from Qiskit and PennyLane using Codex with GPT-5.6-Sol (Ultra). We specifically searched for cases in which each API behaves correctly in isolation, but a permitted composition of APIs produces incorrect behavior. The screening surfaced two candidate counterexamples, Qiskit #4369 ( Qiskit Developers, 2020 ) and PennyLane #534 ( PennyLane Developers, 2020 ) . In both cases, an output accepted as valid by one component is rejected by a subsequent API, producing an explicit exception instead of a silent incorrect result. Thus, no silent bug counterexample to the API-localization criterion was found among the screened reports. Accordingly, we scope this work to API-local silent bugs , whose semantic deviation can be localized to the first library API that transforms a valid input into an invalid output.

paragraphs.en: Inconsistencies with Quantum Semantics and Documentation. Both forms of semantic evidence are illustrated by Qiskit #13079 ( Qiskit Developers, 2024b ) as shown in Fig. 2 . The bug affects the Qiskit API HoareOptimizer , described in the documentation of hoare_opt.py ( Qiskit Developers, 2024f ) for circuit optimization. As shown in Fig. 2 (a), when the control qubit is | 1 ⟩ \lvert 1\rangle , the CX gate can be simplified to an X X gate on the target. This X X gate should cancel with the adjacent X X gate because X 2 = I X^{2}=I , whereas the implementation leaves an extra X X gate in the circuit. The incorrect simplification arises from the internal function _traverse_dag , as shown in Fig. 2 (b). That is, after updating the circuit using substitute_node_with_dag , the subsequent code should process the replacement node but instead continues to process the original node. This behavior violates the quantum circuit semantics that the optimization should preserve and provides direct evidence of the bug. This defect is also exposed by the documentation of substitute_node_with_dag in dagcircuit.py ( Qiskit Developers, 2024e ) , as the function replaces a node and returns a mapping to the newly inserted nodes. Continuing to process the original node after replacement is inconsistent with the documented behavior. Both quantum semantics and documentation provide semantic evidence of the same defect.

paragraphs.en: (C1) Incorporating Quantum Semantics into Source-Level Correctness Reasoning. paragraphs.en: This section presents QuSema, a framework for detecting silent bugs in quantum libraries using semantic evidence from implementations. Inspired by prior work on large language models (LLMs) reasoning about program semantics ( Wei et al., 2025 ) and quantum programming ( Mikuriya et al., 2025 ) , QuSema leverages the reasoning and coding abilities of LLMs to identify semantic deviations by analyzing implementation logic against quantum semantics and documentation.
paragraphs.zh: 本节介绍了 QuSema，一个利用实现中的语义证据来检测量子库中静默错误的框架。 受先前关于大型语言模型（LLM）进行程序语义推理（Wei et al., 2025）和量子编程（Mikuriya et al., 2025）的研究启发，QuSema 利用 LLM 的推理和编码能力，通过分析实现逻辑与量子语义及文档之间的差异来识别语义偏差。

sents.en: Inspired by prior work on large language models (LLMs) reasoning about program semantics ( Wei et al., 2025 ) and quantum programming ( Mikuriya et al., 2025 ) , QuSema leverages the reasoning and coding abilities of LLMs to identify semantic deviations by analyzing implementation logic against quantum semantics and documentation.

paragraphs.en: There are two critical issues in completing such a reasoning process. First, it is unknown how to assign an appropriate analysis scope. More concretely, excessive context may contain irrelevant information that interferes with LLM reasoning ( Blinn et al., 2024 ) , whereas insufficient context may omit information required for correct analysis ( Sheng et al., 2026 ) . Each code segment forms a complete data-flow unit within a library API, allowing a silent bug to be localized to the first segment that introduces a semantic deviation. Subsequent segments may propagate or expose it, as illustrated in Fig. 2 . Second, analyzing the target code segment may require implementation logic defined outside its boundaries. To address both issues in quantum software testing, QuSema adopts a structured analysis around each code segment together with relevant documentation and call relations, which collectively constitute a contextual unit . QuSema analyzes each contextual unit for semantic defects and then determines whether the identified defects can be triggered through library APIs. In this way, QuSema keeps a focused analysis scope while incorporating additional context when needed, which supports more effective LLM reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 完成此类推理过程存在两个关键问题。 首先，如何分配适当的分析范围尚不明确。 更具体地说，过多的上下文可能包含干扰 LLM 推理的无关信息（Blinn 等，2024），而不足的上下文则可能遗漏正确分析所需的信息（Sheng 等，2026）。 每个代码片段在库 API 内部构成一个完整的数据流单元，这使得静默错误可以被定位到首个引入语义偏差的代码片段。 后续片段可能会传播或暴露该错误，如图 2 所示。 其次，分析目标代码片段可能需要依赖其边界之外定义的实现逻辑。 为了解决量子软件测试中的这两个问题，QuSema 围绕每个代码片段采用结构化分析方法，并结合相关文档和调用关系，这些共同构成一个上下文单元。 QuSema 会分析每个上下文单元是否存在语义缺陷，然后判断已识别的缺陷是否可以通过库 API 被触发。 通过这种方式，QuSema 既能保持专注的分析范围，又能在需要时纳入额外上下文，从而支持更有效的 LLM 推理。

sents.en: More concretely, excessive context may contain irrelevant information that interferes with LLM reasoning ( Blinn et al., 2024 ) , whereas insufficient context may omit information required for correct analysis ( Sheng et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 更具体地说，过多的上下文可能包含干扰 LLM 推理的无关信息（Blinn 等，2024），而不足的上下文则可能遗漏正确分析所需的信息（Sheng 等，2026）。

sents.en: Each code segment forms a complete data-flow unit within a library API, allowing a silent bug to be localized to the first segment that introduces a semantic deviation.
sents.zh: 每个代码片段在库 API 内部构成一个完整的数据流单元，这使得静默错误可以被定位到首个引入语义偏差的代码片段。

sents.en: Subsequent segments may propagate or expose it, as illustrated in Fig. 2 .
sents.zh: 后续片段可能会传播或暴露该错误，如图 2 所示。

sents.en: Second, analyzing the target code segment may require implementation logic defined outside its boundaries.
sents.zh: 其次，分析目标代码片段可能需要依赖其边界之外定义的实现逻辑。

sents.en: To address both issues in quantum software testing, QuSema adopts a structured analysis around each code segment together with relevant documentation and call relations, which collectively constitute a contextual unit .
sents.zh: 为了解决量子软件测试中的这两个问题，QuSema 围绕每个代码片段采用结构化分析方法，并结合相关文档和调用关系，这些共同构成一个上下文单元。

sents.en: QuSema analyzes each contextual unit for semantic defects and then determines whether the identified defects can be triggered through library APIs.
sents.zh: QuSema 会分析每个上下文单元是否存在语义缺陷，然后判断已识别的缺陷是否可以通过库 API 被触发。

sents.en: In this way, QuSema keeps a focused analysis scope while incorporating additional context when needed, which supports more effective LLM reasoning.
sents.zh: 通过这种方式，QuSema 既能保持专注的分析范围，又能在需要时纳入额外上下文，从而支持更有效的 LLM 推理。

paragraphs.en: Next, in Stage II, Semantic Defect Detection , QuSema interprets the relevant quantum semantics or documented behavior as semantic constraints on each code segment. Each suspected violation is converted into a testable defect hypothesis with predicted erroneous behavior and validated through execution. Hypotheses supported by the observed results are retained as candidate defects. This stage addresses (C1) by incorporating quantum-specific semantic knowledge into source-level correctness reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，在第二阶段“语义缺陷检测”中，QuSema 将相关的量子语义或文档记录的行为解释为对每个代码段的语义约束。 这些约束构成了源级别的语义预言机，用于识别有效输入可能产生无效输出的条件。 每个疑似违规情况都会被转化为一个可测试的缺陷假设，该假设包含预测的错误行为，并通过执行进行验证。 由观察结果支持的假设将被保留为候选缺陷。 此阶段通过将量子特定的语义知识融入源级别的正确性推理中，解决了问题（C1）。

paragraphs.en: Finally, in Stage III, Library API Triggering and Bug Validation , QuSema determines whether a verified source-level defect can be reproduced through valid use of a documented library API. paragraphs.en: Stage I establishes the scope of semantic analysis. An entire source file may contain substantial logic unrelated to the behavior under examination, while an isolated function may omit dependencies needed to interpret that behavior. Following the localization in Sec. 3.2 , QuSema analyzes individual code segments and retrieves related information as needed. Specifically, a contextual unit contains the target code segment, documentation that constrains its intended behavior, and call relations that provide access to relevant implementation logic. This design keeps the initial reasoning scope focused while preserving access to dependencies that may affect the semantic behavior of the segment. For example, the Qiskit 2.4.1 Rust file standard_gates_commutations.rs ( Qiskit Developers, 2026u ) contains 7,778 lines covering gate metadata, commutation tables, and helper logic. Analyzing the complete file introduces substantial unrelated context, whereas analyzing an extracted function alone may omit referenced tables or surrounding logic required to determine whether its commutation behavior is correct. QuSema therefore constructs contextual units through code segment extraction, call-relation analysis, and documentation association.

paragraphs.en: Code Segment Extraction. QuSema extracts individual code segments from the quantum library source code shown on the left side of Fig. 3 (a). For Python, QuSema uses source positions from the standard ast module ( Python Software Foundation, 2026 ) to extract module-level functions and class methods, while nested functions remain within their enclosing function. For Rust, regular expressions identify module-level functions and functions or methods in impl blocks, with brace-depth tracking determining their boundaries. Functions exposed through PyO3 are also included ( PyO3 Project, 2026 ) . Each segment retains its attached Python decorators or Rust attributes and records its qualified name, signature, source file, and line range. QuSema further partitions the few Rust functions exceeding 1,000 lines while retaining the enclosing function context.

paragraphs.en: Call-Relation Analysis. A code segment may depend on implementation logic defined elsewhere. QuSema records these dependencies for inspection without expanding the initial scope to the entire source file. The Call relations component in Fig. 3 (a) records callers and callees ( Gharibi et al., 2018 ) , together with class references, variable definitions, and cross-language relations. Source locations are retained for inspecting related code. For Python, call targets are resolved from call expressions and import bindings. For Rust, QuSema uses call sites, enclosing impl types, and qualified names. Referenced constants, class attributes, and tables from the same file are included when available. PyO3 export attributes and module registrations connect Rust implementations to their corresponding Python interfaces ( PyO3 Project, 2026 ) . Unresolved calls are retained for later inspection. For partitions of large Rust functions, QuSema also records definitions and updates of local variables outside the partition.

paragraphs.en: Documentation Association. Semantic analysis also requires evidence of the implementation’s intended behavior. QuSema therefore associates each code segment with relevant documentation, as illustrated in Fig. 3 (a). Python docstrings are obtained from syntax-tree nodes, while Rust documentation is collected from documentation comments ( /// and //! ) and the #[doc = ...] attribute ( The Rust Project, 2026 ) . For Python class methods, class-level documentation is also included when it specifies relevant behavior. Documentation from the constructor, resolvable base classes, and directly related classes is included when available. For Rust segments, QuSema resolves documentation from the corresponding Python interface through exported names and containing types, using related #[pyclass] types as fallback. Partitions of large Rust functions retain the enclosing function documentation and relevant gate-class documentation. Documentation sources and missing documentation are explicitly recorded.

paragraphs.en: The design in Stage I of QuSema organizes library code into compact contextual units with explicit links to supporting information. This structure limits irrelevant context while preserving access to dependencies that may affect code behavior. The subsequent semantic defect detection stage can then begin from a focused scope and retrieve additional context when needed.

paragraphs.en: After contextual unit preparation, Stage II of QuSema performs Semantic Defect Detection , as illustrated in Fig. 3 (b). It examines whether the implementation logic of each code segment satisfies the relevant quantum semantics and documented behavior under valid inputs. These semantic constraints form the source-level semantic oracle used to identify conditions under which the implementation may produce an invalid output. QuSema then turns each suspected violation into a testable defect hypothesis and validates it through execution. This process consists of candidate search, defect hypothesis generation, and hypothesis verification.
paragraphs.zh: 在上下文单元准备之后，QuSema 的第二阶段执行语义缺陷检测，如图 3 (b) 所示。 该阶段会检查每个代码段的实现逻辑是否在有效输入下满足相关的量子语义和文档记录的行为。 这些语义约束构成了源级语义预言机，用于识别可能导致实现产生无效输出的条件。 随后，QuSema 将每个疑似违规情况转化为可测试的缺陷假设，并通过执行进行验证。 该过程包括候选搜索、缺陷假设生成和假设验证。

paragraphs.en: Candidate Search. As shown on the left of Fig. 3 (b), QuSema analyzes each contextual unit against the source-level semantic oracle. The LLM identifies the quantum-semantic and documented constraints relevant to the target code segment and examines whether the implementation can violate these constraints under valid inputs. When additional implementation logic is required, it follows the call relations to inspect referenced definitions and related code segments, and may execute exploratory code to examine suspected inconsistencies. QuSema records plausible semantic violations as candidates. Search ends when the LLM determines that no further candidates can be identified in the contextual unit. Each candidate then proceeds individually through the remaining workflow.
paragraphs.zh: 候选项搜索。 如图 3 (b) 左侧所示，QuSema 将每个上下文单元与源级语义预言机进行对比分析。 LLM 会识别与目标代码段相关的量子语义和文档约束，并检查该实现是否在有效输入下可能违反这些约束。 当需要额外的实现逻辑时，它会沿着调用关系检查被引用的定义和相关代码段，并可能执行探索性代码以检验疑似的不一致之处。 QuSema 会将合理的语义违规记录为候选项。 当 LLM 判断在上下文单元中无法识别出更多候选项时，搜索过程即告结束。 随后，每个候选项将独立地继续执行剩余的工作流程。

paragraphs.en: Defect Hypothesis Generation. For each retained candidate, QuSema converts the suspected semantic violation into a testable defect hypothesis, as shown on the upper right of Fig. 3 (b). The hypothesis specifies the triggering input, the erroneous behavior predicted from the implementation, and the quantum-semantic or documented constraint expected to be violated. QuSema then constructs executable test code that directly exercises the target code segment under the identified condition. The resulting hypothesis provides a concrete prediction for subsequent verification.
paragraphs.zh: 缺陷假设生成。 对于每个保留的候选项，QuSema 会将推测出的语义违规问题转化为可测试的缺陷假设，如 Fig. 3 (b) 的右上角所示。 该假设明确了触发输入、基于实现预测的错误行为，以及预期被违反的量子语义或文档约束。 随后，QuSema 会构建可执行的测试代码，在已识别的条件下直接运行目标代码段。 由此生成的假设为后续验证提供了具体的预测依据。

sents.zh: 缺陷假设生成。

paragraphs.en: Hypothesis Verification. As shown on the lower right of Fig. 3 (b), QuSema executes the generated test, compares the observed behavior with the erroneous behavior predicted by the defect hypothesis, and checks whether the claimed semantic violation is justified. If the two do not match or the claimed violation is unjustified, the LLM revisits the triggering condition, test code, and predicted behavior, revises the hypothesis when needed, and repeats the verification. A candidate is retained as a semantic defect only when the predicted violation is reproduced through execution. Otherwise, it is discarded.
paragraphs.zh: 假设验证。 如图 3 (b) 的右下部分所示，QuSema 执行生成的测试，将观察到的行为与缺陷假设所预测的错误行为进行比较，并检查所声称的语义违规是否成立。 如果两者不匹配，或者所声称的违规不成立，LLM 会重新审视触发条件、测试代码和预测行为，在必要时修正假设，并重复验证过程。 只有当预测的违规通过执行被重现时，候选项才会被保留为语义缺陷。 否则，该候选项将被丢弃。

paragraphs.en: The candidate defects from Stage II may either be exposed through valid use of documented library APIs or remain confined to internal implementation logic. The latter do not constitute silent bugs considered in this work. To distinguish these cases, Stage III of QuSema determines whether a verified source-level defect can be reproduced through a documented library API, thereby addressing (C2) , as illustrated in Fig. 3 (c). This stage consists of library API trigger search, which identifies an API and valid input that may expose the defect, and bug qualification, which verifies whether the semantic deviation is reproduced at the API level and determines the final classification.
paragraphs.zh: 来自第二阶段的可疑缺陷可能通过有效使用文档化的库 API 被暴露出来，也可能仅限于内部实现逻辑中。 后一类缺陷不属于本研究所考虑的静默错误。 为了区分这些情况，QuSema 的第三阶段会判断一个经过验证的源代码级缺陷是否可以通过文档化的库 API 重现，从而解决 (C2)，如圖 3 (c) 所示。 该阶段包括库 API 触发搜索（用于识别可能暴露缺陷的 API 和有效输入）以及错误定性分析（用于验证语义偏差是否在 API 层面被重现，并确定最终分类）。

paragraphs.en: Library API Trigger Search. As shown on the left of Fig. 3 (c), QuSema searches for documented library APIs that can reach the verified defect and preserve its triggering condition. The LLM examines candidate APIs and constructs valid inputs that may reproduce the erroneous behavior identified in Stage II, using exploratory execution when needed. QuSema supplements this search with the reverse chain shown in the Auxiliary component of Fig. 3 (c). Starting from the smallest code segment containing the defect, the reverse chain performs a bounded search over CodeQL-derived caller relations ( GitHub, 2026 ) toward documented library APIs. For Qiskit Rust code, PyO3 bindings connect Rust implementations to the corresponding Python classes or methods. These paths identify possible API entries and guide trigger construction. An API and valid input that may reproduce the defect are retained as a trigger candidate. If no valid trigger is found, the candidate receives the workflow status not bug and is not reported.
paragraphs.zh: 库 API 触发搜索。 如图 3 (c) 左侧所示，QuSema 会搜索已文档化的库 API，这些 API 能够触达已验证的缺陷并保留其触发条件。 LLM 会检查候选 API，并构建可能重现第二阶段所识别错误行为的合法输入，必要时使用探索性执行。 QuSema 通过图 3 (c) 中辅助组件所示的反向链来补充这一搜索过程。 从包含缺陷的最小代码段开始，反向链会对基于 CodeQL 的调用者关系（GitHub, 2026）进行有界搜索，以定位已文档化的库 API。 对于 Qiskit Rust 代码，PyO3 绑定将 Rust 实现连接到相应的 Python 类或方法。 这些路径能够识别可能的 API 入口，并指导触发条件的构建。 一个可能重现缺陷的 API 及其合法输入将被保留为触发候选项。 如果未找到任何有效的触发条件，该候选项将被赋予“非缺陷”的工作流状态，且不会被报告。

paragraphs.en: Bug Qualification. As shown on the right of Fig. 3 (c), QuSema determines whether a trigger candidate reproduces the semantic deviation identified in Stage II. For each candidate, QuSema formulates a trigger hypothesis specifying the library API call, input, and expected erroneous behavior, then verifies it using the procedure in Sec. 4.3 . A candidate whose predicted behavior cannot be reproduced is classified as not bug . For a reproduced defect, QuSema checks the triggering input against the API documentation. Cases arising from inputs explicitly permitted by the documented API are classified as bug , while cases involving valid inputs whose support is not established by the documentation are retained as potential bug for developer assessment.
paragraphs.zh: 缺陷判定。 如图 3 (c) 右侧所示，QuSema 会判断某个触发候选项是否复现了第二阶段中识别出的语义偏差。 对于每个候选项，QuSema 会构建一个触发假设，明确指定库中的 API 调用、输入以及预期的错误行为，然后使用第 4.3 节中的流程进行验证。 若某个候选项的预测行为无法被复现，则将其归类为“非缺陷”。 对于被复现的缺陷，QuSema 会将触发输入与 API 文档进行比对。 因文档中明确允许的输入而引发的情况被归类为“缺陷”，而涉及有效输入但文档未明确支持的情况则保留为潜在缺陷，供开发者评估。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the effectiveness and utility of QuSema through the following three research questions:
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过以下三个研究问题来评估 QuSema 的有效性和实用性：

paragraphs.en: RQ1: How does QuSema perform compared with general coding agents and across LLM backends?
paragraphs.zh: 问题1：与通用编码智能体以及不同大型语言模型后端相比，QuSema 的表现如何？

paragraphs.en: RQ2: How do individual components of QuSema contribute to its effectiveness?
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题2：QuSema 的各个组成部分如何共同促使其有效性？

paragraphs.en: RQ3: Can QuSema discover previously unknown bugs in quantum libraries?
paragraphs.zh: 问题3：QuSema 能否发现量子库中此前未知的错误？

paragraphs.en: Subjects and Benchmark. We evaluate QuSema on Qiskit and PennyLane. For RQ1 and RQ2, we construct a benchmark of 20 maintainer-confirmed historical silent bugs, with 10 from each library, and reproduce each bug on its corresponding buggy version. The benchmark covers 10 functionality types, as summarized in Table 1 . For PennyLane #9361 ( PennyLane Developers, 2026g ) and Qiskit #12429 ( Qiskit Developers, 2024a ) , equivalent circuit transformations do not guarantee unchanged resource estimates. For the remaining eight bugs, equivalent circuit variants can be constructed, but their execution results do not expose the defects. For RQ1 and RQ2, each benchmark instance centers on one historical bug. Issue reports, known triggering inputs, fixes, and regression tests are withheld from all methods. RQ1 and RQ2 evaluate defect identification and bug validation under controlled inputs, while RQ3 examines repository-scale discovery. For RQ3, we apply QuSema to the full source code of Qiskit 2.4.1 ( Qiskit Developers, 2026t ) and PennyLane 0.45.0 ( PennyLane, 2026 ) . Table 2 reports the size, documented APIs, and extracted code segments of the two library versions.

For RQ1, we compare QuSema with Claude Code ( Anthropic, 2026a ) using Fable 5 (Max) ( Anthropic, 2026b ) and Codex ( OpenAI, 2026a ) using GPT-5.6-Sol (Max) ( OpenAI, 2026b ) . paragraphs.en: Procedure and Metrics. For RQ1 and RQ2, we evaluate each configuration in three independent runs on the historical bug benchmark. For each bug, we define the root-cause code segment as the first segment along the call chain that produces an invalid output from a valid input. In RQ1, all methods receive this segment, and Claude Code and Codex may inspect other library code as needed. For QuSema, this corresponds to analyzing a single contextual unit. In RQ2, the base QuSema configuration receives the containing source file, while the remaining configurations receive the root-cause segment. Each bug is counted at most once per run, and we report per-run counts and three-run means. A defect is identified when a candidate matches the ground-truth implementation defect and correctly explains how a valid input produces an output violating the relevant quantum semantics or documented behavior. A bug is relocated when the identified defect is reproduced through valid library API use, with executable evidence and a correct explanation of the invalid output. We check the reported root cause, input validity, and semantic explanation using issue reports, documentation, and executable evidence. RQ1 reports bug relocation counts and total cost across three runs. The two RQ2 comparisons report defect identification and bug relocation counts, respectively. For RQ3, QuSema analyzes code segments from the target library versions until 40 previously unknown bugs are identified. We report each unique finding to library maintainers and record its status as fixed , confirmed , pending , or rejected .
paragraphs.zh: 流程与指标。 针对研究问题1和研究问题2，我们在历史缺陷基准数据集上对每种配置进行三次独立运行评估。 对于每个缺陷，我们将根本原因代码段定义为调用链中第一个从有效输入生成无效输出的代码段。 在研究问题1中，所有方法都会收到该代码段，而 Claude Code 和 Codex 可根据需要检查其他库代码。 对于 QuSema，这相当于分析单个上下文单元。 在研究问题2中，基础 QuSema 配置会收到包含该代码段的源文件，而其他配置则会收到根本原因代码段。 每次运行中每个缺陷最多只被计数一次，我们会报告每次运行的计数以及三次运行的平均值。 当候选项与真实实现中的缺陷匹配，并能正确解释有效输入如何生成违反相关量子语义或文档行为的输出时，即认定为一个缺陷。 当通过有效的库 API 使用能够复现已识别的缺陷，并伴有可执行证据以及对无效输出的正确解释时，即认为该缺陷被重新定位。 我们通过问题报告、文档和可执行证据来验证所报告的根本原因、输入有效性以及语义解释。 研究问题1报告三次运行中的缺陷重新定位次数及总成本。 研究问题2的两组比较分别报告缺陷识别次数和缺陷重新定位次数。 对于研究问题3，QuSema 会持续分析目标库版本中的代码段，直到识别出40个此前未知的缺陷。 我们会将每个独特的发现报告给库维护者，并记录其状态为已修复、已确认、待处理或已拒绝。

paragraphs.en: We compare two QuSema configurations with Claude Code and Codex on the historical bug benchmark. As shown in Table 3 , QuSema with Opus 5 achieves the highest mean bug relocation count of 16.00, followed by QuSema with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at 15.67. Claude Code with Fable 5 and Codex with GPT-5.6-Sol achieve mean counts of 14.67 and 13.33, respectively. Thus, both QuSema configurations relocate more historical bugs than the evaluated coding agents. In addition, QuSema with DeepSeek retains nearly all of the relocation performance of the Opus configuration while requiring approximately one-tenth of the cost. It achieves a higher mean relocation count than Claude Code at a lower cost, and achieves a higher mean bug relocation count than Codex with only a modest increase in cost. These results indicate that QuSema can achieve a better effectiveness–cost trade-off than the evaluated coding agents by using a less expensive LLM backend.

paragraphs.en: Beyond relocating the historical target bugs, QuSema also identifies additional defect candidates. paragraphs.en: We conduct two controlled comparisons of QuSema components, as shown in Fig. 4 . The first evaluates Contextual Unit Preparation and the Source-level Semantic Oracle for defect identification, while the second evaluates hypothesis verification for bug relocation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对 QuSema 的各个组件进行了两项受控比较，如图 4 所示。 第一项评估了上下文单元准备和源级语义预言机在缺陷识别方面的表现，而第二项则评估了假设验证在错误定位方面的效果。

sents.en: The first evaluates Contextual Unit Preparation and the Source-level Semantic Oracle for defect identification, while the second evaluates hypothesis verification for bug relocation.
sents.zh: 第一项评估了上下文单元准备和源级语义预言机在缺陷识别方面的表现，而第二项则评估了假设验证在错误定位方面的效果。

paragraphs.en: In the first comparison, the base configuration analyzing complete source files identifies 12–15 defects across three runs, averaging 13.67. Contextual Unit Preparation raises the mean to 15.00, with 15 defects identified in each run, and adding the Source-level Semantic Oracle raises it to 15.67. The larger gain from Contextual Unit Preparation suggests that reducing unrelated context is particularly important for defect identification and improves consistency across runs. The oracle’s additional gain indicates that semantic evidence helps determine correctness when observed behavior alone is insufficient. The two components address complementary sources of failure. Contextual Unit Preparation focuses the analysis on relevant implementation context, while the Source-level Semantic Oracle provides evidence for distinguishing semantic defects from permissible implementation choices.
paragraphs.zh: 在第一次比较中，分析完整源文件的基础配置在三轮运行中识别出 12–15 个缺陷，平均为 13.67。 上下文单元准备将平均值提升至 15.00，每轮运行均识别出 15 个缺陷，而加入源级别语义预言机后，该值进一步升至 15.67。 上下文单元准备带来的更大提升表明，减少无关上下文对缺陷识别尤为重要，并能提高各轮运行之间的一致性。 预言机带来的额外提升说明，当仅凭观察到的行为不足以判断正确性时，语义证据有助于确定正确性。 这两个组件分别解决了互补的故障来源。 上下文单元准备将分析焦点集中在相关的实现上下文中，而源级别语义预言机则提供了区分语义缺陷与允许的实现选择所需的证据。

paragraphs.en: The confirmed bugs span circuit transformation, symbolic computation, commutativity, measurement, resource estimation, serialization, and execution. paragraphs.en: Figure 5 shows two representative silent bugs. In Fig. 5 (a), PennyLane’s BoseWord multiplication (#9650 ( PennyLane Developers, 2026b ) ) produces incorrect results for equivalent operands constructed from identical dictionary entries in different insertion orders. The implementation pairs sorted dictionary keys with values retained in insertion order, which can exchange creation and annihilation operators during multiplication. This symbolic-operator functionality has no direct counterpart in the evaluated Qiskit SDK and no applicable circuit-based metamorphic relation. Figure 5 (b) shows Qiskit #16410 ( Qiskit Developers, 2026n ) in the OptimizeAnnotated pass. The implementation combines nested control modifiers in the wrong order. For an inner open control and an outer closed control, it produces control state 2 instead of 1, changing the control condition and thereby violating circuit semantics without raising an error. The maintainer response ( Qiskit Developers, 2026n ) further highlighted that QuSema pinpointed the underlying root cause:

paragraphs.en: Discussion. QuSema localizes semantic deviations to responsible code segments and reproduces them through documented library APIs. The resulting reports provide root-cause information and user-level triggers that support diagnosis and repair, as also reflected in the maintainer feedback in RQ3. Differential and metamorphic testing rely on comparable implementations or predictable execution relations, whereas QuSema examines implementation logic against quantum semantics and documentation. This allows it to detect confirmed silent bugs in RQ3 for which such relations are unavailable or uninformative.

paragraphs.en: Construct Validity. QuSema relies on LLM knowledge of quantum computing and software to identify defects. This knowledge may be incomplete, and hallucinations ( Kalai et al., 2026 ) may cause incorrect semantic judgments. Hypothesis verification tests these judgments against execution evidence but cannot guarantee reliable detection. Documentation errors ( Xu et al., 2025 ) may therefore affect bug assessment and require maintainer review.

Candidate reports are reviewed manually, so assessment may involve subjective judgment. The checks described in Sec. 5 help limit this subjectivity. paragraphs.en: Quantum software correctness and testing. Research on quantum-software correctness spans language design, formal verification, static analysis, and testing. At the program level, Silq ( Bichsel et al., 2020 ) supports safe automatic uncomputation through its language and type system, while VOQC ( Hietala et al., 2021 ) verifies that circuit optimizations preserve quantum semantics. LintQ ( Paltenghi and Pradel, 2024b ) uses quantum-specific abstractions to statically detect problems in Qiskit programs. Beyond program-level correctness, quantum software testing addresses library reliability. Differential and metamorphic testing detect bugs through cross-library comparisons or semantics-preserving transformations, while KQFuzz ( Xia et al., 2026 ) uses codebase knowledge to guide LLM-based test generation. QuSema instead uses quantum semantics and documentation as source-level correctness evidence for auditing library logic, without requiring predefined relations between executions.
paragraphs.zh: 量子软件的正确性与测试。 量子软件正确性的研究涵盖语言设计、形式验证、静态分析和测试。 在程序层面，Silq（Bichsel 等人，2020）通过其语言和类型系统支持安全的自动反计算，而 VOQC（Hietala 等人，2021）则验证电路优化能够保留量子语义。 LintQ（Paltenghi 和 Pradel，2024b）利用量子特定的抽象概念，在 Qiskit 程序中静态检测问题。 除了程序层面的正确性之外，量子软件测试还关注库的可靠性。 差异测试和形态变化测试通过跨库比较或保留语义的转换来检测错误，而 KQFuzz（Xia 等人，2026）则利用代码库知识指导基于大语言模型的测试生成。 相比之下，QuSema 将量子语义和文档作为源代码层面的正确性证据，用于审计库逻辑，且无需预先定义执行之间的关联关系。

paragraphs.en: LLM-based software analysis and semantic auditing. LLMs support repository-level issue resolution, test and oracle generation, and source auditing. For general software engineering tasks, SWE-agent ( Yang et al., 2024b ) and RepairAgent ( Bouzenia et al., 2025 ) use repository tools to resolve software issues. CoverUp ( Altmayer Pizzorno and Berger, 2025 ) uses coverage and execution feedback to generate tests, while Doc2OracLL ( Hossain et al., 2025 ) uses documentation for test-oracle generation. For source-level auditing, RepoAudit ( Guo et al., 2025 ) validates data-flow and path conditions during repository exploration, whereas RFCAudit ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) checks implementations against RFC specifications and retrieves related source code as needed. QuSema brings source-level auditing to quantum libraries by combining documentation with quantum semantics and validating whether identified defects can be exposed through documented library APIs.

paragraphs.en: This paper presents QuSema, an agentic approach for detecting silent bugs in quantum libraries using source-level semantic evidence. QuSema analyzes implementation logic against quantum semantics and documentation to identify candidate defects. Library API triggering establishes whether these defects produce invalid outputs under valid library use. This approach does not depend on cross-library counterparts or predefined metamorphic relations. Applied to Qiskit and PennyLane, QuSema discovers 40 previously unknown bugs.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了 QuSema，这是一种基于智能体的方法，利用源代码级别的语义证据来检测量子库中的静默错误。 QuSema 通过对比实现逻辑与量子语义及文档来识别潜在的缺陷。 通过触发库的 API，可以确定这些缺陷在有效使用库时是否会产生无效输出。 该方法不依赖跨库的对应实现或预定义的形态变化关系。 将 QuSema 应用于 Qiskit 和 PennyLane 后，发现了 40 个此前未知的错误。
